newsitem.title: CHINA: World Houseware sets HK$100 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: World Houseware sets HK$100 mln loan.

text.p: The following issue was announced by arranger Rabobank Hong Kong branch.
BORROWER WORLD HOUSEWARE (HOLDINGS) LTD
GUARANTORS GUARANTEED BY FIVE OF THE GROUP'S OPERATING
SUBSIDIARIES: WORLD HOUSEWARE PRODUCING CO LTD
WORLD HOUSEWARE PRODUCING (CHINA) CO LTD, WORLD
HOME LINEN MANUFACTURING CO LTD, WELIDY LTD AND
SOUTH CHINA PLASTIC BUILDING MATERIAL MANUFACTURING
LTD
